title: Thermostat Short-Cycling Detection
dataSources: Zigbee2MQTT device reports (`zigbee2mqtt:device`), Shelly/Tasmota telemetry (`shelly:status`, `tasmota:sensor`), Hue bridge events (`hue:event`), Nest/Ecobee thermostat (`ecobee:thermostat`), door/leak/motion sensors.
app: Philips Hue, smart plugs (Tasmota/Shelly/TP-Link Kasa), thermostats (Nest/Ecobee), locks, and Zigbee/Z-Wave sensors via MQTT / Zigbee2MQTT and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ecobee:thermostat
| sort 0 thermostat _time
| streamstats current=f last(hvac_state) as prev_state by thermostat
| eval cycle=if(hvac_state!=prev_state,1,0)
| bin _time span=1h
| stats sum(cycle) as cycles, avg(runtime_min) as avg_runtime by thermostat _time
| where cycles>6 AND avg_runtime<5
| sort - cycles
description: Looks for lots of very short HVAC cycles, the pattern that usually hints at bad tuning, sensor placement, or equipment issues.
value: Short cycling wastes energy and stresses equipment; catching it early is cheaper than waiting for a comfort complaint or a repair bill.
implementation: Forward thermostat state transitions and runtime metrics; review hourly periods with many short cycles.
visualization: Hourly trend of HVAC cycles and average runtime.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks when your heating or cooling keeps turning on and off too quickly instead of running in a healthy steady way.
